metadata.question: Was the nighttime brightness around the Blue Lagoon in Iceland on November 24, 2024, greater than the brightness over Reykjavík at 4 am local time?

data.raw_code: 1. If unavailable, fall back to “NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMCFG” (monthly but still 15-arc-second). - Date: 2024-11-24 (or the monthly composite for November 2024 if daily missing). - Location: Blue Lagoon (63.881°N, –22.453°W) and Reykjavík centre (64.1466°N, –21.9426°W). Both are single pixels, so we use a tiny 500 m buffer. - Band: “avg_rad” (radiance in nW cm⁻² sr⁻¹). 2. Cloud / QA masking - Nighttime DNB already cloud-masked by NOAA; no extra mask needed. 3. import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time
blue_lagoon = ee.Geometry.Point(-22.453, 63.881).buffer(500)
reykjavik   = ee.Geometry.Point(-21.9426, 64.1466).buffer(500)
date = '2024-11-24'

# 2. Data Acquisition
viirs = (ee.ImageCollection("NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG")
           .filterDate('2024-11-01', '2024-11-30'))   # daily subset wrapped inside monthly collection
if viirs.size().getInfo() == 0:
    # fallback to monthly composite
    viirs = ee.ImageCollection("NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMCFG").filterDate('2024-11-01', '2024-12-01')
    if viirs.size().getInfo() == 0:
        print("No 2024-11 VIIRS imagery found.")
        print("<answer>C1</answer>")

img = viirs.first()
band = 'avg_rad'

# 3. Pixel count check
count lagoon = img.select(band).reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
                                             geometry=blue_lagoon, scale=500, maxPixels=1e9).get(band).getInfo()
count_city   = img.select(band).reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
                                             geometry=reykjavik, scale=500, maxPixels=1e9).get(band).getInfo()
if lagoon == 0 or city == 0:
    print("No valid pixels after masking.")
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")

# 4. Calculation
rad_lagoon = img.select(band).reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
                                           geometry=blue_lagoon, scale=500, maxPixels=1e9).get(band).getInfo()
rad_city   = img.select(band).reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
                                           geometry=reykjavik, scale=500, maxPixels=1e9).get(band).getInfo()

# 5. Validation & Answer
if rad_lagoon is None or rad_city is None or ee.Algorithms.IsNaN(rad_lagoon).getInfo() or ee.Algorithms.IsNaN(rad_city).getInfo():
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
print(f"Blue-Lagoon radiance: {rad_lagoon:.2f} nW/cm²/sr")
print(f"Reykjavík radiance:   {rad_city:.2f} nW/cm²/sr")
print(f"Pixels: Lagoon={int(lagoon)} City={int(city)}")
print("<answer>A</answer>" if rad_lagoon > rad_city else "<answer>B</answer>")
